spirit:component.spirit:name: udp_player
spirit:component.spirit:description: Host UDP/VRT sample packets from a 100G CMAC -> RFDC DAC: URAM buffer (+ optional block-RAM play-out chain), timed playout, flow control, ARP and async status, over-the-wire format conversion (sc16/sc8/sc12/fc32). Register map in the HDL header; wire format: the Protocol (top AGENTS.md).
